taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type (file label of “HK” is inconsistent with the resistivity sequence ρ1>ρ2<ρ3<ρ4; the rising ρ3→ρ4 trend confirms an A-type termination, not K)
Aquifer depth: 1.23 – 7.44 m (low-resistivity Layer 2, 97.1 Ω·m)

Recommendation: Target the screen interval between 1.23 m and 7.44 m where the resistivity minimum indicates saturated, likely permeable material; case off the thin, more resistive top layer (0–1.23 m) to prevent surface contamination and confirm lithology with cuttings before setting the screen.
